consequence.statement: A new split interval option is introduced for recent metadata queries to help caching; the evidence states no operational consequence for operators.

assertion.statement: Loki adds a new config option split_recent_metadata_queries_by_interval, a separate split interval applied to recent_metadata_query_window to help cache recent metadata query results.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: New optional setting; the evidence does not state any environment state in which an operator is exposed to a consequence.
